v5_contract.feature_storage: Original float64 bins; no normalization refit; no dense history tensors
v5_contract.fill_age_definition: -1:no original source since split reset; 0:observed; positive:age in bins; weather never filled
v5_contract.target_storage: Observed six-bin mean float32 kW, then original float64 scaling and float32 cast
v5_contract.training_worker_scope: Train IDs/targets and train bin files only; evaluation bins are separate coordinator files

adapter.discovery: exact manifest identity; 24 unique complete main fits

v5_lock.selection: Validation only; test period previously observed; no best-seed selection

b1_verification.verification_method: math.fsum physical residual recomputation; no model forward

b1_lock.immutability: Exclusive atomic no-replace publication; read-only file modes and SHA256 inventory. Local provenance, not external signature or privileged-user tamper protection.
b1_lock.prediction_level_recomputation: Not performed: no saved per-example validation predictions in run schema; summary arithmetic independently verified instead
b1_lock.scope: Validation-selected B1 FedAvg-GRU models only; no March access or test evaluation authorization

selection_rule.comparison: strict < on saved finite binary64 scores in ascending round order
selection_rule.tie_handling: Keep earliest exact minimum; no epsilon and no test-based reselection

t4_config.task: T4 Forecasting Improvement and Controlled Federated Benchmark
t4_config.model_selection_rule: Primary: Validation MAE, Secondary: Validation RMSE

t4_model_selection.selection_rule: Primary: Validation MAE, Secondary: Validation RMSE

t4_communication_accounting.dimension: Estimated Physical Wire Traffic (+2.5% TCP/TLS headers)

baseline_specification.definition: Predicts next-hour mean IT power using the node last observed power step P[t-1] in history.
baseline_specification.name: node_level_persistence

cohort_and_universe.client_definition: Each client represents one compute node at the facility (not independent data centers).
cohort_and_universe.matched_cohort_enforcement: Every window in the comparison must share an identical forecast origin t and identical ground-truth target interval [t, t+6) across 1h, 6h, and 24h history models.

distinction_from_historical_v5.controlled_t1_2_scope: 1h vs 6h vs 24h matched cohort; Jan 01 - Jan 22 train, Jan 22 - 28 val, Jan 28 - Feb 04 test.
distinction_from_historical_v5.historical_v5_scope: 6-hour history only; Jan 01 - Feb 11 train, Feb 11 - 20 val, Feb 20 - Mar 01 test.
distinction_from_historical_v5.isolation_rule: Metrics from historical v5 and the new T1.2 controlled protocol must NEVER be merged or directly cross-compared without explicit notation of protocol change.

evaluation_protocol.model_selection: Minimum validation RMSE checkpoint across 200 rounds. No test-based model selection.
evaluation_protocol.standard_deviation_definition: Sample standard deviation (ddof=1) across three stochastic seeds on one shared dataset; not an independent-dataset confidence interval.

missing_data_tracks.robustness_track: ff30 (causal forward-fill up to 30 minutes, reset at split boundaries)

normalization_protocol.leakage_prohibition: No validation or test windows may enter scaler fitting. Verified by type guards.
normalization_protocol.method: StandardScaler (two-pass float64 mean and variance accumulation)
normalization_protocol.scaler_scope: Input features standardizes over training occurrences; target standardized over training targets.

history_protocol.scientific_objective: Fair, leakage-free comparison of 1h (6 bins), 6h (36 bins), and 24h (144 bins) history inputs for next-hour mean IT power forecasting under simulated FedAvg.

target_specification.target_imputation: STRICTLY PROHIBITED. Only 100% observed finite ground truth power bins allowed.

history_protocol.task: TASK T1.2 Controlled History-Length Comparison Protocol

target_availability.unit: W raw; kW in retained features
target_availability.forecast_support: Next-hour mean node IT power is the existing verified target.
target_availability.caveats: Node IPMI power, not cooling or whole-facility power.
target_availability.raw_count_scope: Representative component, not sum of all alias metrics, except energy/cooling/PUE categories which sum explicitly listed distinct channels. Core counts cover benchmark 979 nodes; core_raw_observations.csv also retains excluded node 0.

target_availability.forecast_support: Counter data exists; physical scope, resets and reliability must be validated before consumption forecasting.
